_note: Versioned DATA, not code (OVERLAY-DESIGN §4). Deterministic expected-ABV bands per category, and the state regulatory-quirk table. Edit here; overlay_detect.py reads this file and falls back to the inline defaults if it is missing or unparseable.

state_quirks.rule: Utah's flavored-malt-beverage rules force a state-specific formulation and SKU for national RTDs; the national code is not the Utah code.
state_quirks.expect: A separate Utah item, usually reformulated to the low-ABV grocery threshold. A national RTD code carried into Utah is either the wrong SKU or a conflated one.

state_quirks.rule: Control states list a restricted size set; sizes outside the state's listed set are not sellable there.
state_quirks.expect: A spirits size that is not in the control board's listing will not have a state code, and a row asserting it is a listing error.

state_quirks.rule: Franchise states bind a brand to one wholesaler; the same item is commonly duplicated across wholesaler-specific codes.
state_quirks.expect: Two item codes for one identity in a franchise state is a wholesaler duplicate, not two products.
